items.caption: A two-stroke 人 in Shang oracle-bone style, shown here as a modern redraw. The source links it to specimen 甲2940 合18901.
items.alt: A narrow, slanting two-stroke figure resembling 人, with one long descending stroke and a shorter stroke branching from it.
items.selection_reason: This candidate offers a clear early-script example relevant to the interpretation of 人 as a profile figure of a person.

items.caption: A seal-script rendering of 人, shown as a modern redraw and labelled Small Seal script in the associated glyph record.
items.alt: A seal-script 人 with a curved top stroke, a long descending left stroke and a sweeping right stroke.
items.selection_reason: This labelled seal-script form adds a distinct, readable example of 人 and complements the oracle-bone style candidate without implying a direct chronological sequence.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redrawings, not photographs of ancient artifacts. The source links the oracle-style drawing to a specimen but does not give that specimen an individual date.
